user.title: Tesla Bridge
user.description: Address of the bridge dashboard, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8090. Token = Bridge__Web__Token from .env – or, if you didn't set one, the token the bridge made (docker compose exec tesla-bridge cat /data/web-token).

reauth_confirm.title: New token
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge rejected the token. Enter Bridge__Web__Token from .env, or the one in the bridge's /data/web-token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the bridge. Check the address and that the dashboard is enabled (Bridge__Web__Enabled).

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.

bridge_too_old.title: Tesla Bridge needs an update
bridge_too_old.description: The bridge runs version {installed}, but this integration needs at least {required}. Update the container on the server, in the bridge's folder: `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`.
